headline: Increase of up to 13% in minimum wage forecast for 2027, would exceed 10,800 pesos per month
summary: Companies and consultancies expect the general minimum wage in Mexico to rise between 12% and 13% in 2027, taking it above 10,800 pesos per month. A smaller adjustment is expected for the northern border zone.
why: Minimum wage changes affect labour costs for employers and consumer spending across Mexico. They are a key input for inflation and wage forecasts.
original_headline: Prevén incremento de hasta 13% al salario mínimo en 2027, superaría los 10,800 pesos mensuales
